entries.title: Psalms 115:1
segments:
PSALM CXV. 
 
  We are to give glory to God, not to ourselves or idols, ver. 1-8.   By trusting in his promise and blessing, ver. 9-15.   And by praising him, ver. 16-18.

entries.title: Psalms 115:8
segments: V. 8. Are like them-As void of all sense or reason as their images.

entries.title: Psalms 115:11
segments: V. 11. Ye that fear-All of you who worship the true God, not only Israelites, but even Gentile proselytes.

entries.title: Psalms 115:12
segments: V. 12. Mindful-In our former straits, and therefore we trust he will still bless us.

entries.title: Psalms 115:13
segments: V. 13. Both small-Of whatsoever quality, high and low, rich and poor.

entries.title: Psalms 115:16
segments: V. 16. The Lord's-In a peculiar manner, where he dwelleth in that light and glory, to which no man can approach.  Given-As the foregoing verse declares, that God was the creator of heaven and earth, so this asserts that he is also their Lord and governor to dispose of all men and things as he pleases.

entries.title: Psalms 115:17
segments: V. 17. Silence-Into the place of silence, the grave.
